altitude.quote: Located at 5140 m elevation in the Atacama Desert of northern Chile

coordinates.locator: CLASS 40 GHz power-spectrum paper (arXiv:2309.00675), Table 1 "Site location (lat/lon) Site elevation"
coordinates.note: Table 1 gives site latitude/longitude to 0.01 degree (about 1 km), in a physics paper (arXiv, rank 10), so the point is recorded as campus-grade/approximate with precision_m = 1000. The 2014 CLASS overview paper says the CLASS site is "near the Atacama B-Mode Search (ABS), Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT), and Polarbear sites on Cerro Toco at an altitude of approximately 5140 m".

place.region: Antofagasta Region (Cerro Toco, near San Pedro de Atacama)

summary.plain: The high-desert site on Cerro Toco, in northern Chile, where the four CLASS telescopes survey the polarization of the Big Bang afterglow over most of the sky.
summary.technical: CLASS site on Cerro Toco at about 5140 m, in the Parque Astronómico Atacama, near the ACT and POLARBEAR sites.
